errorHandling.chatErrorBoundary: Catches React errors in chat component, saves conversation state to localStorage
errorHandling.productionErrorBoundary: Generic error boundary with error reporting and user-friendly UI
errorHandling.apiErrorHandling: Multiple layers - axios interceptors, custom ApiError class, retry logic

userMessages.API_KEY_MISSING: Please configure your OpenAI API key first
userMessages.TIMEOUT: Request timed out. Try simplifying your goal description
userMessages.NETWORK_ERROR: Unable to connect to the server
userMessages.401: Your OpenAI API key appears to be invalid

messageFlow.initialMessage: Generated client-side in initializeChat() - no API call needed
messageFlow.helpRequests: POST /api/v1/goals/contextual-help - provides assistance when user says 'I dont know'
messageFlow.errorFlow: API error -> Axios interceptor -> Error transformation -> User-friendly message in chat

keyFindings: First message works because its generated client-side, not from API
Subsequent messages fail if backend endpoints are not implemented
Error messages are specific: 'System not responsive' for general failures
Production API service has more robust error handling than development
Chat component expects specific response structures from backend
Timeout handling includes retry logic with exponential backoff
API configuration is stored in session storage (production) or memory (dev)
debuggingTips: Check browser Network tab for failed API calls
Look for 404 errors on /component-question and /contextual-help endpoints
Verify OpenAI API key is being sent in headers
Check if goal ID is properly saved and retrieved
Monitor console for detailed error logging
Test endpoints directly with test scripts in root directory
